ui.welcome: Namaste, main hoon SAFEx Guard. Online fraud aur cyber scam se bachne mein main aapki madad karunga. Aaj main aapki kya help kar sakta hoon?
ui.triage_prompt: Kripya batayein aapke sath kya situation hai:

triage_options.label: Mere sath fraud ho chuka hai
Mujhe kuch suspicious lag raha hai
Main safe rehne ke tarike seekhna chahta hoon

ui.happened_prompt: Aapke sath kya incident hua? Neeche select karein taaki hum turant protective action le sakein:

happened_options.label: Paise kat gaye / transfer ho gaye
Account ya WhatsApp hack ho gaya
Blackmail ya dhamki mil rahi hai
OTP, PIN ya Aadhaar share kar diya

ui.learn_prompt: Aap kis safety topic ke baare mein jaanna chahte hain?
ui.emergency_body: Turant action lein! Shuru ke 2-3 ghante (Golden Hour) transaction freeze karne aur paise bachane ke liye sabse zaroori hain.
ui.listening: Aapki aawaz suni ja rahi hai...
ui.tap_to_talk: Bolne ke liye mic tap karein
ui.ai_unavailable: AI assistant abhi offline hai. Local safety guide dikhai ja rahi hai.
ui.rate_limited: Sawal poochne ki limit poori ho gayi hai. Kuch minute wait karein ya offline guide use karein.
ui.offline: Aap abhi offline hain. Guard ka offline guide active hai.
ui.disclaimer: SAFEx Guard safety guidance deta hai, legal ya financial advice nahi. Hum live website ya phone number verify nahi kar sakte.
ui.masked_notice: Aapki sensitive details (OTP, PIN, Card, Aadhaar) phone par hi mask ho jati hain.
ui.empty_videos: Is topic par abhi koi video available nahi hai.

topics.chip_label: Email check karein (kya ye real hai?)
topics.empathy_opening: Bahut accha kiya ki aapne email ke kisi link par click karne se pehle check kiya.
topics.headline: Hurry ya warning dikhane wale emails aksar fake (phishing) hote hain.
why: Scammers official companies ke naam se milte-julte emails banate hain.
Fake links aapko duplicate login page par le jakar credentials chura lete hain.
Attachments mein spyware ho sakta hai jo phone ko infect karta hai.
Asli banks kabhi email par turant account closure ki dhamki nahi dete.

do_now.text: Hamara quick email safety checker run karein.
Sender email address dhyan se check karein (jaise support@sbi-updates.xyz).
Kisi bhi link par click na karein aur file download na karein.
Phishing email ko incident@cert-in.org.in par report karein.

dont: 'Update KYC' ya 'Claim Refund' jaise buttons par click na karein.
Unknown source se aayi ZIP, HTML ya APK file install na karein.
Email reply mein apna phone number ya banking details na bhejein.

follow_up_chips.label: Maine pehle hi link click kar diya
Kisi ne QR code bheja hai

topics.chip_label: Suspicious call aayi hai, kya karun?
topics.empathy_opening: Calm rahiye aur panic mat kijiye. Scammers jaanbujhkar dar ka mahol banate hain.
topics.headline: Pressure banane ya official banne wale calls aksar fraud hote hain.
why: Fraudsters police, FedEx, TRAI ya bank officer bankar phone karte hain.
Ve Caller-ID spoofing use karte hain taaki number real lage.
Sim block ya arrest ki dhamki dekar OTP ya paise demand karte hain.

do_now.text: Quick call check checklist start karein.
Turant phone kaat dein. Kisi stranger ko explanation dene ki zaroorat nahi.
Chakshu portal (Sanchar Saathi) par suspicious call report karein.
Agar bank ka naam liya tha, toh card ke peeche diye helpline par call karein.

dont: Call par bane na rahein aur video call join na karein.
Caller ke kehne par AnyDesk, TeamViewer ya RustDesk install na karein.
Phone par koi OTP na batayein aur keypad par koi number press na karein.

follow_up_chips.label: Ve Digital Arrest ki baat kar rahe hain
Unhone OTP ya PIN maanga

topics.empathy_opening: Apne accounts par 2FA lagana hackers se bachne ka sabse powerful step hai.
topics.headline: Two-Factor Authentication 99% automatic hack attacks ko rok deta hai.
why: Agar password leak bhi ho jaye, tab bhi bina second code ke koi login nahi kar sakta.
Authenticator apps (jaise Google Authenticator) SMS OTP se zyada safe hain.
Backup recovery codes ensure karte hain ki aap kabhi account se bahar lock na hon.

do_now.text: Google/Gmail: Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification open karein.
WhatsApp: Settings > Account > Two-Step Verification > Enable karein.
Social Media: Settings > Accounts Center > Password and Security > 2FA turn on karein.
Bank Apps: Official bank app mein biometric ya transaction pin lock lagayein.

dont: Apna 2FA OTP ya 6-digit authenticator code kisi ke sath share na karein.
Backup codes ko plain unencrypted text mein save na karein.
Menu names badal sakte hain; app ke official help page ko zaroor check karein.

follow_up_chips.label: Mera account already hack ho gaya hai
Kisi ne OTP maanga tha

topics.chip_label: Kisi ne mera OTP ya PIN maanga hai
topics.empathy_opening: Bahut accha hua ki aapne share karne se pehle check kiya. Aapke paise bach sakte hain.
topics.headline: Koi bhi genuine bank, police ya company aapse OTP ya PIN nahi maangti.
why: OTP aur UPI PIN aapke bank account aur paise ki digital chaabi hote hain.
Scammers dar ya jaldbazi dikhate hain taaki aap dhyan na de sakein.
1 rupee ka verification transaction bhi poora account khali kar sakta hai.

do_now.text: Kuch bhi share na karein. Turant phone kaat dein ya reply band karein.
Agar OTP ya PIN de diya hai, toh turant 1930 par call karein.
Bank ke card ke peeche wale official number par call karke card/UPI block karwayein.

dont: OTP, PIN, CVV ya card number kisi ko na batayein.
Caller ke bheje kisi link par click na karein.
Unke kehne par koi screen share ya APK app install na karein.

follow_up_chips.label: Maine share kar diya aur paise kat gaye
Kaise pata karein ki call fake hai?

topics.chip_label: Paise kat gaye / Fraud transaction hua
topics.empathy_opening: Yeh situation stressful hai, lekin aap akele nahi hain. Chaliye turant recovery steps lete hain.
topics.headline: Turant 1930 par call karein. Golden Hour mein complaint karne se paise freeze ho sakte hain.
why: Stolen paise kuch ghanton mein multiple accounts mein transfer ho jate hain.
1930 par call karne se Citizen Financial Fraud system receiver account turant freeze karta hai.
Bank ko turant inform karne se RBI rules ke mutabik dispute strong hota hai.

do_now.text: Abhi isi waqt 1930 helpline par call karein.
Apne bank emergency number par call karke account aur UPI block karwayein.
Transaction details (UTR ID, time, amount, payee) note karke rakhein.
cybercrime.gov.in par complete complaint file karein.
Screenshots aur SMS save rakhein; chats delete na karein.

dont: Paise wapas paane ke chakkar mein scammer ko aur paise na bhejein.
Google par helpline numbers search na karein (fake ads hote hain).
Puri recovery ki guarantee koi nahi de sakta, lekin fast reporting best chance hai.

follow_up_chips.label: Maine card ya Aadhaar bhi share kiya tha
Mera WhatsApp ya email compromised hai

topics.chip_label: Kya yeh link ya QR code safe hai?
topics.empathy_opening: Link open karne ya QR scan karne se pehle check karna bahut samajhdari ka decision hai.
topics.headline: Paise RECEIVE karne ke liye kabhi bhi QR code scan ya UPI PIN enter nahi karna hota.
why: QR code scan karne se hamesha aapke account se paise katte hain.
Phishing links bank page ki copy karke aapka password chura lete hain.
Short links ke peeche dangerous APK download links chupe ho sakte hain.

do_now.text: Agar koi paise bhejne ke liye QR scan karne ko bole, toh bilkul na karein.
Website domain ke ek-ek spelling ko dhyan se check karein.
Safe verification ke liye SAFEx URL Scanner use karein.

dont: OLX ya WhatsApp par bheje gaye QR codes ko scan na karein.
Lottery prize, subsidy ya free gifts ke links open na karein.
Paise aate time kabhi bhi UPI PIN na daalein.

follow_up_chips.label: Maine UPI PIN daal diya aur paise kat gaye
Link mein Aadhaar ya PAN manga tha

topics.chip_label: Ve bol rahe hain ki main 'Digital Arrest' hoon
topics.empathy_opening: Ghabraiye mat. Indian law mein 'Digital Arrest' jaisa koi rule nahi hai. Aap bilkul safe hain.
topics.headline: Real Police, CBI ya ED kabhi bhi video call par kisi ko arrest ya interrogate nahi karte.
why: Scammers fake police uniform pehante hain aur video call par fake warrants dikhate hain.
Ve jhoota arop lagate hain ki aapke Aadhaar se drugs ya money laundering hui hai.
Ve 'RBI verification' ke naam par paise transfer karne ko bolte hain jo 100% scam hai.

do_now.text: Turant WhatsApp ya Skype video call kaat dein.
Turant 1930 Cyber Crime Helpline par call karein.
Apne family ya close friend ko turant batayein; akele kamre mein na baithein.
cybercrime.gov.in portal par extortion report karein.

dont: Case khatam karne ke naam par 1 rupya bhi transfer na karein.
Camera ke aage baithe rehne ya kisi se baat na karne ka unka order na maanein.
Video call par apna bank passbook ya Aadhaar card na dikhayein.

follow_up_chips.label: Maine darr ke mare paise transfer kar diye
Ve photos se blackmail kar rahe hain

topics.chip_label: Mera account ya WhatsApp hack ho gaya
topics.empathy_opening: Panic mat kijiye. Sahi steps lene se hacked accounts usually wapas mil jaate hain.
topics.headline: Safe device se password change karein aur sabhi active sessions se logout karein.
why: Hackers malware, SIM swap ya leaked password ke zariye access paate hain.
Ve aapke contacts ko message karke emergency paise maangte hain.
Ve recovery email aur number change karke aapko lock kar dete hain.

do_now.text: Kisi safe phone se turant apna password change karein.
Security settings mein jakar 'Log out of all devices' karein.
Recovery email aur backup phone number update karein.
Family aur dosto ko alert karein ki aapke naam se kisi ko paise na bhejein.
Authenticator app se 2FA enable karein.

dont: Same compromised password ko doosre apps mein use na karein.
Unknown SMS se aaye recovery links par click na karein.
New device login warning alerts ko ignore na karein.

follow_up_chips.label: 2FA setup kaise karein
Account se paise bhi kat gaye hain

topics.chip_label: Photos ya video se blackmail / dhamki
topics.empathy_opening: Isme aapki koi galti nahi hai. Aap akele nahi hain, himmat rakhein aur calm rahein.
topics.headline: Blackmailer ko ek bhi rupya na dein. Paise dene par ve aur zyada maangte hain.
why: Scammers morphed images ya recorded video calls se dara kar paise vasoolte hain.
Ransom dene se extortion kabhi nahi rukta, balki ve baar baar maangte hain.
Cyber police ke paas offensive content ko internet se hatane ka formal system hai.

do_now.text: Kisi bhi haal mein koi paise na bhejein.
Chats, QR codes, phone number aur profile links ke screenshots lein.
Scammer ko WhatsApp aur social media par turant block karein.
1930 par call karein ya cybercrime.gov.in par formal complaint darj karein.
Agar bahut distress mehsoos ho, toh Tele-MANAS helpline (14416) par baat karein.

dont: Blackmailer se request ya negotiation na karein.
Evidence delete karne ke chakkar mein pehle chat delete na karein.
Khud ko guilty na maanein. Yeh ek planned cyber crime hai.

follow_up_chips.label: Maine pehle hi kuch paise bhej diye
Unke paas mera Aadhaar aur contacts hain

topics.chip_label: Aadhaar, card ya personal details share kar di
topics.empathy_opening: Yeh kisi ke sath bhi ho sakta hai. Abhi timely action lene se aap misuse ko rok sakte hain.
topics.headline: UIDAI par Aadhaar biometrics lock karein aur cards turant freeze karwayein.
why: Card details leak hone par unauthorized transactions ho sakte hain.
Aadhaar aur OTP misuse karke fake SIM ya personal loans liye ja sakte hain.
Time par lock karne se unauthorized authentication attempts block ho jate hain.

do_now.text: Bank ko call karke debit ya credit card block karwayein.
UIDAI portal ya mAadhaar app se Aadhaar biometrics lock karein.
Net banking aur emails ke passwords change karein.
Unknown loans check karne ke liye CIBIL/Credit report periodically dekhein.

dont: Phone par aane wale naye OTP ko approve ya share na karein.
Old banking passwords ko dobara reuse na karein.
Unverified agents ko physical documents na dein.

follow_up_chips.label: Mera paisa kat chuka hai
2FA security kaise enable karein

checkers.title: Email Safety Checker
checkers.intro: In 6 sawalon ke jawab dekar check karein ki kya yeh email dangerous phishing scam hai.

questions.text: Kya email mein KYC update, account block se bachne ya refund ke liye link click karne ko kaha gaya hai?
Kya email 24 ghante mein account band hone ya legal notice ki urgency create karta hai?
Kya isme password, OTP, UPI PIN, Card CVV ya Aadhaar details maangi gayi hain?
Kya sender ka email domain fake ya misspelled lag raha hai (jaise support@sbi-updates.xyz)?
Kya email mein koi unexpected ZIP, HTML ya APK attachment hai?
Kya isme bina apply kiye lottery prize, tax refund ya instant job ka offer hai?

LOW_RISK.headline: Low Risk Signs Found
LOW_RISK.body: Koi obvious phishing indicator nahi mila, lekin yaad rakhein koi bhi automatic tool 100% safety guarantee nahi karta. Passwords ya OTP kabhi share na karein.

SUSPICIOUS.headline: Suspicious Email Signs
SUSPICIOUS.body: Is email mein scam patterns hain. Kisi bhi link par click na karein aur official number se verify karein.

LIKELY_SCAM.headline: High Danger: Confirmed Phishing Email!
LIKELY_SCAM.body: Critical phishing indicators detect hue hain. Yeh email data chori karne ke liye bheja gaya hai. Reply na karein aur incident@cert-in.org.in par report karein.

checkers.title: Call Safety Checker
checkers.intro: In 6 sawalon ke jawab dekar jaanchein ki kya caller koi scammer ya imposter hai.

questions.text: Kya caller ne khud ko Police, CBI, ED, Customs, TRAI ya courier (FedEx) bataya?
Kya unhone kisi crime ka ilzam lagaya ya immediate arrest ya SIM disconnection ki dhamki di?
Kya unhone call/video par continue rehne aur family ko na batane ka instruction diya?
Kya unhone paise, OTP, UPI PIN ya 'verification account' mein paise bhejne ko bola?
Kya unhone koi app (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk) download karne ya screen share karne ko bola?
Kya call kisi unknown international number ya suspicious WhatsApp video call se aayi?

LOW_RISK.headline: No Obvious Scam Signals
LOW_RISK.body: Regular safety follow karein: phone par kisi ko bhi OTP, password ya confidential information na batayein.

SUSPICIOUS.headline: Suspicious Call - Be Cautious
SUSPICIOUS.body: Caller suspicious lag raha hai. Call cut karein aur card ke peeche diye official helpline par contact karein.

LIKELY_SCAM.headline: High Threat: Scam Call Detected!
LIKELY_SCAM.body: Yeh digital arrest ya remote access scam ka case lag raha hai. Turant call disconnect karein aur 1930 par report karein.

checkers.title: Link and QR Checker
checkers.intro: Kisi bhi link ko open karne ya QR code scan karne se pehle in baton ka dhyan rakhein.

questions.text: Kya link mein 'https://' missing hai ya standard website ke bajaye koi IP address dikh raha hai?
Kya domain kisi trusted brand ki copy kar raha hai (jaise sbii-online, incometax-refund)?
Kya kisi ne aapko paise 'receive' karne ke liye QR scan karne ko bola hai?
Kya website phone mein direct koi APK file download karne ko bol rahi hai?

LOW_RISK.headline: No Direct Threat Found
LOW_RISK.body: Carefully proceed karein. Hamesha address bar mein domain spelling confirm karein.

SUSPICIOUS.headline: Suspicious Link Traits
SUSPICIOUS.body: Is link mein risky features hain. Is website par password ya card details na daalein.

LIKELY_SCAM.headline: Scam Link or QR Code!
LIKELY_SCAM.body: Fraud ka high risk hai. QR scan na karein aur UPI PIN enter na karein.
